description: This file defines the BuzzShareDecorator class, which provides methods to manipulate and decorate BuzzShare entity objects, including adjusting comment and like counts and setting an employee reference.

classes.name: BuzzShareDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class to extend functionality for the BuzzShare entity, including setting employee references and adjusting comment and like counts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the BuzzShare entity to be decorated.

methods.name: getBuzzShare
methods.description: Returns the BuzzShare entity being decorated.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the BuzzShare entity by employee number.

methods.name: increaseNumOfCommentsByOne
methods.description: Increments the number of comments on the BuzzShare entity by one.

methods.name: decreaseNumOfCommentsByOne
methods.description: Decrements the number of comments on the BuzzShare entity by one.

methods.name: increaseNumOfLikesByOne
methods.description: Increments the number of likes on the BuzzShare entity by one.

methods.name: decreaseNumOfLikesByOne
methods.description: Decrements the number of likes on the BuzzShare entity by one.
